title: Access request needs manager approval
symptom: User asks for access to a restricted finance folder
user_description: I need access to the finance reports folder. My manager said it's fine. Can you just add me?

options.text: Add him because he says his manager agreed
options.why: A verbal claim is not proof. Anyone can say their manager agreed.

options.text: Add him now and ask for approval later
options.why: Access once given may be used straight away. Approval must come first.

options.text: Ask for a written approval from his manager and the data owner through the proper request, then grant only the access needed
options.why: Written approval creates a record and stops people granting themselves access. Granting only what is needed limits risk.

options.text: Copy a colleague's permissions to him
options.why: Copying can give him more access than he needs, including things he should never see.

hints: Who decides who may see finance data?
How much access should you grant?
real_world_tip: Keep requests in the ticket. When someone later asks who approved the access, the record answers it.
